maintenance_led.reason: Sells consumables like Reynolds Wrap foil, Hefty trash bags and food bags, used up in normal use, not repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Household products sold through retailers to consumers; Reynolds Wrap and Hefty are paid for by private shoppers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling and launching products under Reynolds and Hefty brands; only occasional acquisitions, such as Hefty–Fabuloso licensing.

mission_critical.reason: Foil, trash bags and food storage bags are commodity-like household items; consumers and retailers can switch brands easily, including to private label.
